Steffen ECKARDT (Garmin Health SDK Support):
Mon, 21 Oct 2024 at 10:18Subject: Garmin Health Standard SDK - Avicenna Research, Ticket: 160744To: mohammad <mohammad@avicennaresearch.com> ##- Please type your reply above this line -## Steffen ECKARDT (Developer Program) Oct 21, 2024, 16:18 GMT+2 Hi Mohammad, I’ve granted Avicenna Research access to the Standard SDK on the Garmin Developer Portal. You were already set up as the admin for another Garmin Developer Program, so it will just show up as another offering to you in the Dev Portal. As admin, you can invite other developers from your company. Please see the attached instructions for further details. All the documentation for the SDK is in the SDK download itself. When you’re ready to start developing, please request licenses by emailing sdksupport@health.garmin.com and providing the package ID (app/bundle ID) of the project you’ll be using for evaluation (e.g. com.<Company Name>.mobile). Also, please be sure to direct all technical questions to sdksupport@health.garmin.com. While cross-platform application frameworks may be used to develop applications utilizing the Health SDK, support will be limited to native aspects of SDK behavior. SDK support is unable to address issues arising from SDK interaction with cross-platform frameworks and partners may be required to reproduce issues in a native environment such as the sample applications included with the SDK. Please be aware that this evaluation use of the SDK is meant for INTERNAL DEVELOPMENT PURPOSES ONLY. As specified in the evaluation agreement, if you need to do a pilot study involving people external to your company, Garmin will need to review and approve your application(s). Also, commercialization of your application(s) is not allowed under the evaluation agreement that we have in place -- please contact your Garmin Sales representative to discuss those options. Best Regards / Freundliche Grüße / CordialementSteffen ECKARDT Garmin Connect Partner Services Reminder: Please also do not forget to add your team members to the portal by clicking on your company name and "members" after your first login. Support for unverified persons will not be provided and sharing access/documentation may result in your apps/access being revoked. Attachment(s) Dev-Portal_add-member_process.pdf [Y0YNR6-G20E2] -- Mohammad HashemianFounder, Chief Executive Officer, Avicenna Research Inc. (formerly Ethica Data) ᐧ------
